messages:
Anya: Quick sync — we shipped v1.2 yesterday. CS surfaced 6 regressions and ~8 enhancement asks. Need a short plan: fix-first for critical customer pain, batch smaller asks into next sprint. Proposing 2 buckets: PATCH (48h) and NEXT-WAVE. Agree?
Derek: +1. Can we map which ones are infra vs product? That changes ETA.
Marta: I can share short list and impact ranks from customers — two accounts blocking onboarding, one intermittent crash.
Anya: Sending list now. Priority proposal: 2 P0s (crash + onboarding blocker), 3 P1s (performance & a data mismatch), rest P2+.
Chai: I can take the crash P0 and the perf P1. Derek can you pick up the data mismatch?
Derek: I can. Data issue looks like schema edge-case in the ingestion pipeline; likely a small migration and a guard. P0 crash needs a quick revert path if patch fails.
Oscar: For the UX regressions (P2s), can we bundle them into a small polish ticket for next-wave? Design effort is ~2 days for all three.
Anya: That works. For clarity, here's the triage labels I'm using (copying to channel):
```
P0: crash/data-loss/blocker for core flow
P1: hotpath perf >2s, data incorrect but recoverable
P2: UX annoyance, docs, small polish
Spike: needs design/arch before estimate
```
Marta: Customers A and B are P0/P1 respectively. Customer C flagged a reproducible repro (stack trace attached) — they'll expect a patch.
Chai: repro looked like a race in session creation. Quick fix candidate: add a sync point and retry logic. I'll push a draft PR tonight.
Derek: Data mismatch requires a migration script + backfill; estimated 1.5 days dev + 1 day validation. Can we schedule that into the PATCH window or do we put it NEXT-WAVE?
Anya: Because it affects onboarding flows, mark it P1 but allow 72h if needed. If migration touches user data we need approvals — @Marta please capture customer consent lines.
Marta: noted — I'll get written signoff from legal/customer tomorrow morning.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for v1.2.1-patch started on canary-1 at 2025-06-08T16:12Z :rocket:
Chai: PR opened: fix/session-retry. Tests passing locally, adding e2e now.
Oscar: If we roll a hotfix, design QA path: quick visual regression pass + one flows test. I can do that in the morning.
Anya: Release criteria for PATCH: 1) canary runs 4h with no new errors 2) e2e smoke green 3) rollback plan documented 4) CS notified with ETA. If any item fails, we hold.
Derek: Ack. I'll land migration behind feature flag then coordinate backfill after patch.
Chai: If canary looks good I'll open the PR to prod with the revert script included.
Marta: I'll send proactive comms to the two customers: timeline + workaround.
Anya: OK folks — plan set: Chai on crash P0, Derek on data P1 (migration behind flag), rest P2 into next sprint. Can we reconvene in 6 hours with status? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Derek: 6h ok.
Chai: 👍
Oscar: Can do design QA in that window.
deploy-bot: Canary healthy after 4h check. No new error spikes.
Anya: Great — moving to patch deploy. I'll create the patch release ticket and assign owners. Final note: keep change set minimal, log the rollback commands in the ticket.
Marta: Thanks — I'm on customer comms and will escalate if anything changes.
Anya: Closing this thread for now. Will post final postmortem if we needed an emergency rollback. :thumbsup:
